risks.title: Economic risk
risks.score_rationale: The company states that unfavorable economic conditions may negatively affect its business growth and operating results. Macroeconomic events including changes in trade policies, inflation fluctuations, and interest rates may slow customer IT spending.

risks.title: Increased competition
risks.score_rationale: The company notes that competition is a significant factor in acquiring new customers and increasing sales with existing customers. The effectiveness and pricing of competing products may impact acquisition and expansion capabilities.

risks.title: Dependence on technology and innovation
risks.score_rationale: Datadog's success depends on its ability to maintain a leadership position in technology and innovation. The company must continue developing its platform with over 20 products and maintain its differentiation.

risks.title: Risk of contract non-renewal
risks.score_rationale: Subscription contracts are typically monthly or annual, and customers may choose not to renew. The net retention rate reflects the significance of this risk, although currently positive at 120%.

risks.title: Revenue fluctuation risk
risks.score_rationale: Revenues may fluctuate due to revenue recognition over the subscription contract term. The subscription model creates potential variability based on contract cycles.

risks.title: International expansion risk
risks.score_rationale: Datadog intends to expand its operations internationally, which may present risks related to geopolitics, regulation, and operational complexity.

ai_positioning.summary: Datadog positions itself as an AI-powered observability and security platform for cloud applications. The company explicitly mentions its AI-powered approach in its main platform description.
